entities.name: Leandros
entities.description: An Akroan warrior of the Alamon who patrols Akros's perimeter and is sole survivor of his squad.

entities.name: Alamon
entities.description: Akroan squads who roam the city perimeter to keep it clear of dangers.

entities.name: Kyrillos
entities.description: Captain of Leandros's squad, killed by the minotaur leader.

entities.name: Haemon
entities.description: Young squad member killed by the minotaur leader.

entities.name: Nikasios
entities.description: Handsome squad member who lost a leg.

entities.name: Xanthos
entities.description: Stalwart squad member killed by a minotaur.

entities.name: Mnesos
entities.description: Scholarly squad member killed in the fight.

entities.name: Diocles
entities.description: Elderly squad member whose arm was broken.

entities.name: Pallas
entities.description: Tall athletic squad member wounded in the chest.

entities.name: Bardas
entities.description: Squad member and friend of Borias, killed.

entities.name: Borias
entities.description: Squad member and friend of Bardas, killed.

entities.name: Eumalos
entities.description: Leader of another Alamon squad, found dead.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: Horde that trapped the Alamon and laid siege to Akros.

entities.name: One Eye Pass
entities.description: Pass where the squad was ambushed.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God to whom the squad prayed.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God resuming his feud with Iroas.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God resuming his feud with Mogis.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Leandros's squad is sent to investigate after Eumalos's squad misses its checkpoint, and kills a charging cyclops.
events.quote: Leandros's squad was sent there to investigate

events.summary: The squad finds Eumalos and his squad dead and headless, then is trapped by a boulderfall.
events.quote: They were all dead, their heads missing.

events.summary: The minotaurs ambush the squad in a brutal battle.
events.quote: Then the minotaurs charged in, led by an especially large specimen.

events.summary: The minotaur leader kills Haemon and Kyrillos; Leandros fells it and Pallas decapitates it.
events.quote: Leandros felled the large beast, and Pallas decapitated it.

events.summary: Leandros, the only uninjured survivor, is sent running to warn Akros.
events.quote: He reached the top and ran, not looking back.

events.summary: Leandros reaches Akros to find the minotaurs' siege already in progress.
events.quote: The minotaurs had built a wall surrounding the city, and he was unable to reach it.

relations.quote: They surely meant to lay siege to Akros.
Mogis and Iroas resumed their ancestral feud
